description: Depreciation schedule — Asset depreciation schedule: straight line, double declining (ddb), 150% declining (db150) with switch to straight line, sum-of-years digits (syd), units of production (units with total_units= and units=), or US MACRS (method=macrs, life=3|5|7|10|15|20 half-year IRS table, or 27.5|39 mid-month with placed=YYYY-MM; optional bonus= percent and section179= amount).
